component.name: Data Cleaner
component.summary: Safely clean browser data, caches, and temporary files

description.p: Data Cleaner is a native GNOME application that helps you safely reclaim disk space by cleaning browser data, application caches, temporary files, and user-defined directories.

ul.li: Browser cleanup: Clear cache, history, and cookies from Firefox, Chrome, Chromium, Brave, and Edge
Application caches: Clean caches from package managers and applications
Custom directories: Add your own cleanup rules with file patterns and age filters
System cleanup: Clear temporary files, thumbnails, and trash
Safe by design: Preview before deleting, hard-coded protection for critical paths

description.p: Data Cleaner prioritizes safety and transparency. Manual cleanups are previewed, automatic cleanups require explicit opt-in, and critical system paths are protected by a hard-coded denylist.

screenshot.caption: The main dashboard showing reclaimable space

description.p: Initial public release of Data Cleaner.

ul.li: Modern GNOME interface with light and dark themes, system accent colors, high contrast, and reduced motion support
Dashboard storage overview for used, available, total, and reclaimable disk space
Safe browser, application cache, system, custom directory, application log, and system journal cleanup
Scheduled automatic cleanup with multiple selected days, local time, and optional start at login
Lightweight visual Storage Analyzer for finding large files and folders and moving selections to Trash
In-app cleanup log showing deleted, skipped, and failed items after every cleanup
System tray integration with an adaptive symbolic icon and quick cleanup actions
Startup update check with access to the latest verified GitHub release
Critical-path protection, safety limits, symlink controls, previews, and running-browser checks
English, Greek, Italian, Spanish, German, and French interfaces with automatic language detection
